extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Fun with Paint — Paint tools: pencil (draw freehand), brush (thick strokes), eraser (remove drawing), fill bucket (fill closed area with color), shapes (rectangle, circle, line), color palette (choose colors). To draw: select tool, choose color, draw on canvas. (2) File management — folders organize files neatly. Create folder: right-click > New > Folder > type name. Subfolders: folders inside folders for better organization (e.g. School > Class3 > Homework). Move files: drag into folder. Good organization makes files easy to find. (3) Deleting and Recycle Bin — delete: select file > press Delete key. Deleted files go to Recycle Bin (not permanently gone). Restore: open Recycle Bin > right-click file > Restore (file goes back to original location). Empty Recycle Bin: permanently deletes files (cannot be restored). (4) Computer etiquette — keep food and drinks away from keyboard, clean screen with soft cloth, do not pull cables, close programs properly (don't force shutdown), save work regularly, handle laptop gently, ask teacher for help if something goes wrong. (5) Keyboard shortcuts — Ctrl+C (copy), Ctrl+V (paste), Ctrl+X (cut/move), Ctrl+Z (undo), Ctrl+A (select all). Copy = duplicate, Cut = move, Paste = place copied/cut item, Undo = reverse last action. Misconceptions: 'deleting a file destroys it forever' (files go to Recycle Bin first and can be restored), 'folders and files are the same' (folders CONTAIN files, files contain data), 'Ctrl+X and Ctrl+C are the same' (Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+X cuts/moves — the original is removed after paste), 'eating near the computer is fine' (food and drinks can damage keyboard and computer), 'Paint is only for drawing lines' (Paint has fill, shapes, brushes, and many colors). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function PaintFilesGame), NOT export default. Export interface PaintFilesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
